title: A MacMahon Analysis View of 4 Diagonal DSPPs
summary: We study skew double-shifted plane partitions with three-element profiles using MacMahon's partition analysis. We present new generating function formulas for these partitions, incorporating an extra bound on the number of non-zero diagonal elements. These objects are closely related to the Göllnitz-Gordon and little Göllnitz identities. Moreover, we investigate some infinite hierarchies of $q$-series identities that stem from our formulas.
